author: Dandrista
title: Looking for 2D anime artist for Jinx and Pokémon illustrations
content: LONG THREAD ALERT! I am looking for a 2D artist (or artists) specializing in the anime style, with experience drawing Jinx and Pokémon! If you are interested, please drop your VGen link! (DMs will be blocked, unless you have worked with me previously.) #vgen #VgenComm I want to share more precise details about what I’m looking for, as there were some misunderstandings regarding my request! I’ll break it down to help you better understand what I need: 2 PFPs with Jinx in Pokémon Masters EX outfits (Zekrom, Jolteon), Twitch/YouTube Banner with Luna Snow, Jinx, Goku, Twitch Panels (Domain Expansion with Kratos/Reze/Link, Jinx versions, Dragon Miku, Asta slash), and 8 illustrations including Jinx in various outfits (Wolverine, Monster Hunter, Pokémon Z-A professor with Porygon2, etc.). In total 8 separate illustrations. Budget is $120–$150 for the whole project, open to negotiation. Contact: drop your VGen link or DM with "Voy a Jinxearte, culiaaaao" and VGEN profile.
